network.name: Internal Network
network.author: Thomas Shaw
network.description: A NIC on the organisation's internal network (untagged, on a given Proxmox bridge), for systems that must reach an internal service such as the Spark LLM gateway, e.g. a system running llm_relay. Add it alongside the system's lab network: <network type="internal_network"/>. It is not part of the lab network map (no lab IP or VLAN), it survives the post-build removal of the provisioning NIC, and modules on the same system see it as the fact secgen_internal_network ("dhcp" or the static IP). Only students' VMs must never have one. Proxmox only; other providers skip it.
